arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Wolfman stated the Federal Circuit awarded attorney fees to Richlin.
He noted the court denied market-rate paralegal fees.
He argued statutory attorney fees exclude paralegal work.
Mr. Yang stated the Act authorizes two distinct expense categories.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Equal Access to Justice Act lets private parties recover legal costs from the government. The dispute centers on whether paralegal work counts as attorney fees. Richlin argues paralegal fees are separate expenses. The government claims a statutory cap limits all non-attorney costs.
